keyLimits.en: Messenger, shared inbox, ticketing, pre-built reports, public help center; includes Fin AI Agent
Multiple team inboxes, workflow automation, round robin assignment, private/multilingual help center; 20 free Lite seats
SSO & identity management, HIPAA support, SLAs, multibrand messaging; 50 free Lite seats

addOns.en: Fin AI Agent: $0.99 per resolved outcome, charged once per conversation

cautions.en: Seat price is only the base cost; Fin AI resolutions bill separately per outcome and can add up quickly at volume.

capabilities.en: Fin AI Agent resolves customer conversations across chat, email and phone, with a reported ~76% average resolution rate across customers
Omnichannel shared inbox with AI-powered ticketing for customer issues and internal collaboration
Copilot gives real-time AI assistance to human agents inside the inbox
Public, private and multilingual help center / knowledge base shared by AI and human agents

limitations.en: Fin needs to be trained on company processes and policies to perform well; it hands off complex queries to human agents
No free plan; a paid seat is required even to trial most features

reason.en: Direct competitor in helpdesk/support software with similar omnichannel ticketing.
Simpler, cheaper shared-inbox support tool aimed at smaller teams than Intercom.
Lighter-weight live chat and support inbox alternative, more budget-friendly for solos and small teams.
Live chat + AI chatbot for support, positioned as a lower-cost alternative to Intercom.

unknowns: Exact annual discount percentage for seat plans not stated on the pricing page seen
Full list of Fin AI outcome definitions and spend-limit controls not detailed beyond the summary
